description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot configuration class 'Config' for the Sigfox adapter. It sets up bean definitions, configuration properties, and validation for the Sigfox adapter in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for Sigfox adapter, provides bean definitions, configuration validation, and metrics setup.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the Sigfox Protocol Adapter requires authentication, throws exception if not.

methods.description: Sets default name for downstream sender factory if not specified.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for registration client factory if not set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for credentials client factory.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Provides Sigfox protocol adapter configuration properties with prefix 'hono.sigfox'.
